name: browl state database
desc:
The schema of browl's **state database**, generated from the code by [tbls](https://github.com/k1LoW/tbls) (`make schema-docs`; overview in [docs/SCHEMA.md](../../SCHEMA.md)). Edit `.tbls/state.yml`, not these pages.

browl keeps this SQLite file, `DATA_DIR/state.sqlite3`, for the load job's state (stage, generation numbers, errors), shared by all the app's workers, and later the admins. It's authoritative and persistent, and migrates forward from its recorded version when browl starts ([DESIGN.md 2.4](../../DESIGN.md#24-load-pipeline)).

tables.name: job
tables.comment: The latest load job (browl.jobs.JobState), at most one row: each job replaces the previous one's. Times are ISO 8601 with a time zone.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Always 1, so the table has at most one row.

columns.name: generation
columns.comment: The job's generation number, one more than the previous job's.

columns.name: stage
columns.comment: The stage the job is in, or reached (ready), or failed in (browl.jobs.Stage).

columns.name: finished_at
columns.comment: When it reached ready or failed; NULL while it runs.

columns.name: failed_stage
columns.comment: The stage it failed in; NULL unless it failed.

columns.name: reason
columns.comment: Why it failed, cut to MAX_REASON_CHARS; NULL unless it failed.

columns.name: ready_generation
columns.comment: The generation of the latest job that reached ready, this one or an earlier one; NULL if none has.

columns.name: reasoner
columns.comment: The reasoner the admin chose (browl.jobs.Reasoner); 'none' skips the reasoning stage.

columns.name: upload_name
columns.comment: The uploaded file's name, as the admin's browser gave it; NULL if none.

columns.name: upload_bytes
columns.comment: The file's size; while uploading, or after a failed upload, how much arrived.

columns.name: imports
columns.comment: The ontology's imports, direct and indirect, as a JSON list of browl.jobs.ImportResult; '[]' until the imports stage lists them.

columns.name: triples
columns.comment: How many triples the store's default graph holds once loaded, the ontology without its imports.

tables.def:
CREATE TABLE job (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
        generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
        stage TEXT NOT NULL,
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        finished_at TEXT,
        failed_stage TEXT,
        reason TEXT,
        ready_generation INTEGER
    , reasoner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', upload_name TEXT, upload_syntax TEXT, upload_bytes INTEGER, imports TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', triples INTEGER)
